ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to 15% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous distribution of high-contrast white circular and elliptical blobs (mottling) scattered across both lobes, with higher density observed towards the distal tips and the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels along the posterior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into a convex sweep at the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular, high-intensity pixel clusters ranging from 2-10 pixels in diameter, consistent with barnacle-related pigmentation loss.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular erosion and jagged loss of surface area at the distal tip of the lower-positioned lobe.
